entries.name: Nanobots
entries.content:
Monique's nanobots are an special wonder of engineering, working together to map and act on human body within a few hours after ingested. A single dose of those bots can cure cancer over less than a year of treatment. Those nanobots can last over 20 years without breaking and are made so they remove themselves in the urine once they're almost breaking.

However, Monique made those with extra functions. They can trigger different body functions by command like force someone to urinate, to puke, to gag, trigger symphtoms like fever, sweat, make someone erect or impotent, even "turn off" a limb. Those machines with the right software could control everything inside someone's body.

entries.name: MoJa Company
entries.content:
The company that was born after Monique forced her way to the top. Monique used her nanomachines to manipulate the scenary around her discovery, making her a lot of money and turning her the most influential scientific person at the present time. Monique bought the company that first presented the nanobots to the world, then changed it's name to her own - MoJa, that is basicaly a short way of saying "Monique Jackson". 
MoJa started applying dirty tricks to manipulate the market, selling their products at a loss to break competition, buying all the other nanobots factories around the world and quickly becoming a monopoly. Goverment tried to force a duopoly situation but the company that was born out of this resolution is also secretly being controlled by Monique in the shadows and isn't even relevant to mention, it's just another branch of MoJa.
